sentences.en: They said they were peppered with shotgun pellets as they walked in the forest.

sentences.en: The fries are made from pellets of pulverised potato.

sentences.en: Each capsule contains between 30 and 100 pellets of morphine sulphate according to the strength of dose required.
sentences.vi: Mỗi viên nang chứa từ 30 đến 100 viên morphin sulphat tùy theo độ mạnh của liều lượng cần thiết.

sentences.en: Beetles bury pellets of dung and lay their eggs within them.

sentences.en: Flake or pellets can be ground down fine enough even for a dwarf cichlids using a coffee grinder.
